verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm agent-oriented docs: a live llms.txt at pydantic.dev/llms.txt with an agent-facing 'Querying This Documentation' section, and markdown versions of doc pages (overview.md) that point agents to the llms.txt index. A product-scoped llms.txt also exists at pydantic.dev/pydantic-ai/llms.txt. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration that agents consume these docs effectively, and no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant.
